leads.title: Anti-Discrimination Act / Antidiskriminacni zakon (2009), Section 2
leads.documents: Bans discrimination on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, education, housing and access to goods and services; provides legal definition of direct discrimination.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Discrimination protections' section with direct quote of Section 2; no URL or footnote number visible in provided text.

leads.title: Constitutional Court decision striking down adoption ban for registered partners (2016)
leads.documents: Struck down ban on adoption by those living in registered partnership; allows LGBT individuals and concurrent adoption by same-sex partners.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Adoption and family planning' section as 'Ban on adoption by those living in registered partnership was struck down by the Constitutional Court in 2016'; no URL visible.

leads.title: Constitutional Court ruling on forced surgery and sterilization of transgender people (May 2024)
leads.documents: Ruled forced surgery/sterilization requirement for legal gender change unconstitutional; gave government 18 months until June 2025 to change laws.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Gender identity and expression' section; no URL or case number visible in provided text.

leads.title: Health Ministry announcement on legal gender change (July 2025) + Trans*Parent response
leads.documents: Announced transgender people no longer required to undergo surgery or hormone treatment to officially change legal gender; trans rights group Trans*Parent welcomed but warned need for full legislative reform to prevent reversal.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Gender identity and expression' section; no URL visible.

leads.title: CNN Prima News interview with President Milos Zeman (27 June 2021)
leads.documents: Documented incident of anti-trans rhetoric by head of state: claimed not understanding transgender people, called sex-reassignment self-harm/crime, said 'These transgenders truly disgust me.'
leads.detail: Cited in-text with date, outlet CNN Prima News, and direct quotes; no URL visible.

leads.title: Registered Partnership Act (2006) and 2024 Civil Code compromise effective 1 January 2025
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex couples: 2006 registered partnership law (Chamber 16 Dec 2005, Senate 26 Jan 2006, veto by President Vaclav Klaus overturned 15 March 2006, in force 1 July 2006); 2024 compromise equating partnerships to marriage except joint adoption, step-child adoption permitted.
leads.detail: Legislative history detailed in 'Recognition of same-sex relationships' section; no URL visible.

leads.title: Military anti-discrimination provision (1999) and transgender service cases
leads.documents: Since 1999 Czech law prohibited sexual orientation discrimination in military; documents enforcement gaps: rejection of trans woman Jaroslava Brokesova in 2004 after transition, another trans recruit rejected 2014 for alleged 'reduction in morale', trans identity no longer considered relevant by 2015.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Military service' section; no URL visible.

leads.title: Fundamental Rights Agency (FRA) EU LGBT discrimination survey (2012)
leads.documents: Human-rights report on enforcement/living conditions: 93,000 LGBTQ respondents EU-wide; Czech results on family openness, workplace openness, avoidance of holding hands in public for fear of assault/threat/harassment.
leads.detail: Cited in-text in 'Living conditions' section as 'In 2012, Fundamental Rights Agency performed a survey'; no URL visible.

leads.title: Pew Research Center poll (2013) and Eurobarometer surveys
leads.documents: Documents societal acceptance/legal climate context: Pew 2013 on homosexuality acceptance; Eurobarometer 2006, 2015, 2023 on support for same-sex marriage and same-sex relations.
